Type: remediation discovered in F03.3 (claude-console audit, 2026-10-15)
Work key: F03.4.R1
Related: F03.4 (bd-01M4W5P5RX4RKKKDM2NSCV30RY)

Scope: PostgresCatalog.readRun checks the run owner and Propose on the destination only. ADR 002 "Run status/log/output inspection" requires appropriate input/output and evidence permissions; run initiation is not perpetual access.

Acceptance criteria:
1. readRun (and any status/log/output projection) rechecks current read authority on every input scope and evidence authority for disclosed parameters/paths, under the shared policy guard.
2. A run owner whose input grant is revoked receives the uniform denial; completedRun's existing ReadContent check stays.
3. PostgreSQL test with input revocation between start and status read.
